entries.title: AIOC is the central governed development operating system
entries.summary: AIOC is the authoritative coordination layer for Multiversal development. Browser UI, Codex, ChatGPT-compatible clients, and future agents should operate against the same governed state rather than maintain isolated project memories.
entries.rationale: A shared operating system prevents fragmented context, duplicate work, unverifiable updates, and browser-only state loss.

entries.title: Canonical content promotion remains governed
entries.summary: Shared drafts, local readiness, review packages, and AI-generated proposals are not canonical game-ready content until owner approval, repository validation, certification, and promotion complete.
entries.rationale: This boundary protects provenance, stable IDs, release integrity, and owner authority.

entries.title: Build Development Brain Release A before expanding browser features
entries.summary: Current priority is to complete canonical project memory, unified inventory, and dependency graph so later content-completion work can be prioritized by impact and structural correctness.
entries.rationale: The foundation prevents extensive development of duplicate, component, or parent-granted records as independent game objects.

entries.title: Browser working state is not yet fully synchronized with shared state
entries.summary: Some AIOC working objects, structure decisions, and evidence may still exist only in browser localStorage until browser synchronization with the hosted shared-state service is implemented and verified.
entries.rationale: Repository-backed shared state and MCP tools exist, but the browser migration path is not yet the sole source of working-state truth.

entries.title: Live verification is required after deployment changes
entries.summary: CI success alone is insufficient. Deployment work must compare repository and deployed commits and verify required live routes, assets, behavior, and certified content count before success is claimed.
entries.rationale: Earlier successful workflow runs still left stale or incomplete browser behavior visible on the public site.

entries.title: Which records should be consolidated before completion work?
entries.summary: The certified source set contains over-fragmented labels such as item-specific attack actions. The structure pipeline must classify records as standalone, reusable generic, parent component, granted variant, duplicate, or obsolete before full development.
entries.rationale: Incorrect granularity would multiply authoring, balance, validation, and maintenance costs.

entries.title: WP-011 remains the external Mac-dependent application task
entries.summary: The Tauri iOS/iPadOS spike remains blocked on one-time access to a suitable Mac. AIOC Development Brain work may continue without redefining or displacing WP-011.
entries.rationale: The AIOC and Multiversal application workstreams are related but distinct; infrastructure work must not erase the governed application roadmap.
